steps: Click through Mr. Rebates to an online store before shopping.
Make your first purchase through the portal to trigger the $5 bonus.
Earn at least $5 more in cashback so available rebates exceed the $10 payout threshold.
Request payment via check, PayPal, or Venmo once rebates show as Available.
timing: Bonus awarded with first purchase; payout requestable once available rebates exceed $10 — checks paid monthly (usually the 1st).
who_pays: Mr. Rebates pays you. The online stores you shop through pay Mr. Rebates a commission for sending them the sale, and Mr. Rebates shares it with you as cashback — the $5 is a sign-up bonus on top of that.
who_qualifies: You need to be a new Mr. Rebates member — joining is free and takes minutes. The program is focused on US and Canada shoppers.
work_available: Yes — the "$5 bonus with first purchase" offer is on the live official homepage, verified September 2026, with no published end date. This is a one-shot new-member bonus, not an ongoing earning loop.
what_gets_accepted: Only genuine purchases you click through to from the Mr. Rebates portal count — returned or canceled purchases don't. The bonus is awarded with your first purchase through the portal, and you can request a payout once your rebates show as "Available" and total more than $10.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Joining is free — no upfront fee. But you must spend your own money on a real first purchase to trigger the bonus, and the $5 alone can't be cashed out: your first purchase needs to earn at least $5 more in cashback before you hit the $10 payout threshold. This is a discount on shopping you'd do anyway, not income — expect 10–20 minutes plus waiting for rebates to become available.
when_cash_arrives: $5 bonus with first purchase; payout requestable once available rebates exceed $10 — checks paid monthly (usually the 1st).

speed_history.rationale: The monthly check run is the structural blocker.
